arabic_html:
قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ
لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ
إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۞
hook:
If your sins feel
too many to forgive.
translation: Say, O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: however many or great the sins, one must not despair — the door of repentance and mercy is wide and expansive. With sincere repentance, the verse promises, Allah forgives them all.
explanation_vo: As Ibn Kathir explains, however many or great the sins, one must not despair, for the door of repentance and mercy is wide and expansive. With sincere repentance, the verse promises, Allah forgives them all.
